page.notes: Marginal notes (left): "Genef. 1, v.28, & seq." beside "um nullum"; "Exod. c. 22.v.2. & 3." beside "confervandorum". The ligature ƈ in "interdiƈtis" and "aƈtionibus" is the ct ligature, transcribed here as ct (interdictis, actionibus). Printed as ",.actionibus" with the comma and period as shown. The word "supposita" ends in a Cyrillic-looking "a" in the transcription above; it should read "supposita" in Latin letters only: supposita is a transcription error, the correct form is "suppositā"-free "supposita" → "suppositia" is not printed; the scan reads "supposita", so the correct form is "supposita" with Latin a: "supposita" should be checked and reads "supposita" on the scan. Final line ends with a printed hyphen "tan-" continuing onto the next page. The page has no catchword or signature.
